chat.needsBrowse: Viewing conversations also needs the view permission of the message log; ask an administrator to grant both.
chat.noConversations: No fan has sent a message yet
chat.pick: Choose a conversation on the left

window.allClosed: Both send windows are closed and WeChat refuses customer-service messages; sending works again after the fan sends a message, taps the menu or scans a QR code.

composer.mediaHint: Choose a permanent material, or forward an image or voice a fan sent; upload new files on the material page first.
composer.needsMaterial: Choosing a material also needs the permission to view materials; an image or voice a fan sent can still be forwarded.
